svg.title: Multi-Agent E-Commerce Architecture
svg.desc: Full system diagram: React frontend, FastAPI backend with JWT, LangGraph multi-agent system with parallel execution, Groq LLM, and SQLite database.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the user interact with the frontend?')
sendPrompt('How does the Chat page work in the React app?')
sendPrompt('What does the Products page display?')
sendPrompt('How does the Cart page manage cart state?')
sendPrompt('What does the Orders page show?')
sendPrompt('How does login and register work?')
sendPrompt('How does the JWT auth middleware validate tokens?')
sendPrompt('What does the POST /chat endpoint do?')
sendPrompt('What does GET /products return?')
sendPrompt('How does POST /cart manage items?')
sendPrompt('What does GET /orders return for a user?')
sendPrompt('How do /register and /token endpoints work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Supervisor node classify user intent?')
sendPrompt('What tools does the ProductSearch agent use?')
sendPrompt('What tools does the CartManager agent use?')
sendPrompt('What tools does the OrderTracker agent use?')
sendPrompt('How does the Result Merger combine agent outputs?')
sendPrompt('How does Groq Llama 3.3 70B handle tool-call loops?')
sendPrompt('What columns does the users table have?')
sendPrompt('What does the products table store?')
sendPrompt('What does the cart_items table contain?')
sendPrompt('How does the orders table relate to order_items?')
sendPrompt('What does the order_items table store?')
